meetings.ours_headline: Commission waived T-ball field fees, went no-dogs there for the season; skate park still awaits town attorney
Parks Commission votes to fund the part-time recreation director's FY27 salary from its revolving account as a one-year trial

votes.motion: approve the Marshall Park 90' Diamond Score Board proposal and replacement with the agreement that the score board brace encompasses the length and height of the memorial plaque
votes.quote: c. sulivan moved to approve the marshall park 90' diamond score board proposal and replacement with the agreement that the score board brace encompasses the length and height of the memorial plaque. seconded by t. o'dall. call for the vote: c. sullivan-aye, k. menard-aye, d. burns-aye, t. o'dall-aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: appropriate up to $31,000 from the Park Commission Revolving Account to fully fund the salary of the part-time recreation director position for FY2027 on a one-time trial basis
votes.quote: k. menard moved to appropriate up to $31,000 from the park commission revolving account to fully fund the salary of the part-time recreation director position for the fy2027 on a one-time trial basis. the purpose of this trial is to evaluate whether the position can become self-supporting through recreation programming revenue under its current operational structure. the recreation director will provide a one-year detailed strategic plan with periodic financial reporting. seconded by d. burns. call for the vote: c. sullivan-aye, k. menard-aye, d. burns- aye, t. o'dall-aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0)

votes.motion: approve the April 22, 2026, meeting minutes
votes.quote: c. sulivan moved to approve the april 22, 2026, meeting minutes. seconded by k. menard. call for the vote: c. sullivan-aye, k. menard-aye, d. burns-abstain, t o'dall-abstain. the motion passed (2-0-2).

votes.quote: k. menard moved to appoint c. sullivan as chair and d. burns as vice-chair of the commission for the fy27 term. seconded by t. o'dall. call for the vote: c. sullivan-aye, k. menard-aye, d. burns-aye, t. o'dall-aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).
